auditor_sam: Hey team — SOC2/ISO evidence request. We observed an RBAC change (rolebinding rb-3075) during an incident triage for CVE-2026-0450 on 2026-05-10. Need packaged evidence: raw CloudTrail KMS events showing no key material export, a concise rollback timeline/note, and remediation artifacts (PR + deploy IDs). Also include any EKM/HSM access logs if applicable.

pat-security: Got it. We'll prefer raw CloudTrail JSON + SIEM correlation logs. We'll also include an envelope-proof artifact with HMAC if the HSM produced it.

violet-sre: Assembling artifacts now. Presigned bucket: s3://redwood-iso/evidence/1823459999/
- cloudtrail_kms_1823459999.json.gz
- siem_rbac_alerts_3821.log.gz (rule id: SIEM-3821)
- rb-3075-rollback-note.txt
- cve-0450-remediation.md
- ekm_access_audit.log.gz (HSM connector)
- manifest-signed.txt (SHA256 + sig)

own-eng: Rollback note (brief):
"2026-05-10T16:22:34Z rollback rb-3075 by owen-eng via ops-playbook v3.2. Reason: canary detected privilege expansion affecting read/write to admin:credentials. Revert completed at 16:33Z; canary returned green. Ticket: IR-5090."

pat-security: CloudTrail excerpt (snippet):
```
{
  "eventTime": "2026-05-10T16:19:12Z",
  "eventName": "GenerateDataKey",
  "userIdentity": { "type": "AssumedRole", "arn": "arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-rbac-agent/agent-42" },
  "requestParameters": { "keyId": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/zz99-yy88" },
  "responseElements": { "ciphertextBlob": "..." }
}
```

pat-security: EKM/HSM log excerpt shows a local wrap operation, no external peers:
`HSM_CONN: wrapKey id=zz99-yy88 caller=rbac-agent-42 result=OK recipient=local`

pat-security: We produced an envelope-proof file (base64 HMAC + signer metadata) at s3://redwood-iso/evidence/1823459999/kms-envelope-proof.b64. HMAC verified against compliance key ck-23.

evidence-bot: Automated check: manifest-signed.txt signature verified (key id ck-17). Hashes match archived artifacts. :white_check_mark:

auditor_sam: This is great. A couple of small asks: 1) paste the first two lines of rb-3075 rollback-note.txt inline for the packet; 2) provide the PR link for the CVE patch and the deploy tags (canary + full deploy); 3) were any PutKeyPolicy/DisableKey/UpdateKeyDescription events recorded for the CMK in the 16:00-17:00Z window?

own-eng: rb-3075 rollback (first two lines):
"Reverted rb-3075 2026-05-10T16:22:34Z by owen-eng. Canary flagged expanded admin scope; rollback applied via ops-playbook v3.2."

violet-sre: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/security/pull/1508
Deploys: deploy-usw2-20260510-21, canary-20260510-6

pat-security: Confirming KMS policy events: no PutKeyPolicy, DisableKey, ScheduleKeyDeletion, or UpdateKeyDescription events for key zz99-yy88 between 2026-05-10T15:30Z and 2026-05-10T17:30Z. There is an unrelated scheduled rotation event on 2026-04-28.

auditor_sam: Excellent. Last thing — can you also include a short note mapping these artifacts to control CC6.2 and ISO A.9.2 in the manifest (one sentence each)? If not here, append to the manifest in the S3 path.

own-eng: Will do. I'll update manifest-signed.txt with mapping lines: 
- CC6.2: RBAC change + rollback + KMS logs demonstrate detection and timely remediation.
- ISO A.9.2: Access rights reviewed and emergency rollback performed; no key export observed.

auditor_sam: Thanks all — I'll attach these to the evidence packet. If we need additional signed attestations from HSM ops, I'll request. :thumbsup:
